subject: general
question: ‘Justice for the Judge’ is the autobiographical work of which retired Chief Justice of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ranjan Gogoi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Justice Ranjan Gogoi served as the 46th Chief Justice of India from October 3, 2018, to November 17, 2019.
 
• He is known for his pivotal role in landmark judgments, including the Ayodhya land dispute case.
 
• His autobiography, "Justice for the Judge," provides an insider's perspective on his tenure in the Indian judiciary.
 
• The book addresses various significant events and controversies during his time in office, offering a detailed account of his judicial philosophy and decisions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ayodhya Verdict:**

 
 
• Justice Gogoi headed the five-judge bench that delivered the historic verdict on the Ayodhya land dispute on November 9, 2019.
 
• The judgment allotted the disputed land for the construction of a Ram temple and provided an alternative site for a mosque.
 
 
 
• **Assam NRC:**
 
 
• He played a crucial role in the finalization of the National Register of Citizens (NRC) in Assam.
 
• The NRC aimed to identify illegal immigrants in the state and was a significant and contentious exercise.
 
 
 
• **Office of the Chief Justice (RTI):**
 
 
• The Supreme Court under his tenure ruled that the office of the Chief Justice of India is a public authority under the Right to Information (RTI) Act.
 
• This decision was seen as a step towards greater transparency in the judiciary.
 
 
 
• **Rajya Sabha Nomination:**
 
 
• In March 2020, Justice Gogoi was nominated to the Rajya Sabha by the President of India.
 
• His nomination sparked debates about the independence of the judiciary and post-retirement roles of judges.
